decided_by.description: Who decided, often someone at the customer.

id.description:
The record's id. A stakeholder of the company; a scope item or access request of the
project, or on a company's canvas of any of its projects.

LinkKind.description: The kind of record a shape stands for.

role.description: The caller's WorkOS role in the organisation.

attendees.description: The workspace's users who took part; each must work on the company or project.

stakeholders.description: The company's stakeholders who took part.

ProjectPatch.description: A change to some of a project's fields: a field left out stays as it is, `null` clears it.

ProjectSummaryOut.description: A project in a company list.

decided_by.description: Who decided, often someone at the customer.

rationale.description: Why; defaults to the thread's opening comment.

content.description:
What the change set: the item or criterion, or for `signed_off` the whole signed scope
(`stakeholder`, `items`, `criteria`). Null for changes logged before content was kept.

signed_off.description: Whether the latest sign-off covers the current version.

version.description: Bumped by every change to the items or criteria.

chunk.description: The chunk's place in the document, from 0.

score.description: Fused rank score; only its order means anything.

stakeholder.description: The person at the customer who signed off.

stage.description: One stage forward, or back to any earlier stage.

role.description: Their part in the engagement; `other` if left out.

title.description: Their job at the customer, e.g. "VP Engineering".

eval_run.description: The eval run that showed it.

kind.description: What sort of system, e.g. "CRM" or "data warehouse".

assignee.description: The WorkOS user who works it.

blocked_by.description:
The project's access request it is blocked on, only while `blocked`: once the request is
granted, the task goes back to `todo`.

blocker.description: What blocks the task; required when the status is `blocked`.

waiting_on.description: The stakeholder at the customer it waits on.

blocked_by.description: The access request it is blocked on.

waiting_since.description: When it started waiting on the customer; set while the status is `waiting_on_customer`.

decision.description: The decision it was promoted to.

oneOf.description: A task that is not done.
An access request that is not granted, with the name of the stakeholder who owns it.

TodayItemOut.description: Something that needs the FDE, tagged by `kind`.

week.description: The Monday of the ISO week it covers, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

session.name: __Host-fde_session
session.description: The browser session from /auth/callback. A request carrying it, and no bearer token, that is not GET or HEAD must also send `X-Oryxa-Request: 1` and the web app's `Origin`, or it gets 403 {"error":"csrf"}. While WorkOS cannot refresh an expired session, any request may get 503 {"error":"unavailable"}: the cookie is kept, and the same request works once WorkOS answers.
